source.description: Fani 2019 T-24h pre-event reconstruction — synthetic approximation of IMD RSMC best-track parameters. Wind/pressure values derived from IMD post-event report. Surge and rainfall are scenario assumptions at T-24h, not official T-24h forecasts.

source.description: Synthetic rainfall scenario for T-24h Fani replay. 200mm/24h is a scenario estimate consistent with documented 48h totals. Replace with GPM IMERG event aggregate from GEE pipeline.

_notes.surgeNote: Surge height of 1.5m is a T-24h scenario estimate. Documented landfall surge was ~3.5m (IMD/INCOIS). The scenario value represents what might be reasonably assumed 24h before landfall without official INCOIS pre-event product.
_notes.windNote: 220 km/h at T-24h is based on IMD post-event report track data. Actual T-24h intensity may differ from this approximation.
_notes.rainfallNote: 200mm/24h is a synthetic estimate. Replace with actual GPM IMERG event accumulation from GEE pipeline.
_notes.trackNote: Track coordinates are approximations from IMD post-event best-track report, not operational forecast track.
_notes.informationFirewall: All fields in this file reflect pre-event information only. Post-event actuals (observed surge 3.5m, final track, satellite flood extent) are stored separately in data/historical/fani/actual/ and must never be imported in the prediction pipeline.
